📚 PCAF MONTHLY ACADEMY FREE WORKSHOPS 📚

✨ Marketing and Selling Online with Alicia Rutigliano @aliciarose_art
Thinking about opening an online shop, but not sure where to start?

Join PCAF Academy for a workshop with freelance and convention artist Alicia Rutigliano, who'll cover the essentials of setting up an online store, building your brand and planning your launch, breaking the process down into manageable steps.

RECOMMENDED: Bring along your product ideas, merchandise samples, sketches or moodboards, and get ready to brainstorm!

When: Sunday November 1st, 2pm - 4pm
Where: State Library of WA, Georgraphe Room, ground floor (fully accessible)

Header art by @worf_episode

PCAF STORIES KIDS - Looking for a FRIEND Edition.

PCAF Stories Kids is BACK, and this year we’re on the hunt for friendship in the wild and wonderful universe of comics!

Get ready for big laughs, awesome stories, unexpected surprises and a whole lot of comic-book fun! 

Join comics geniuses Gavin Aung Than (@zenpencils), Blair Caulfield, Kai Lyons (@kailyonsart), Maddy Macaulay (@mimizigs) and MC Aśka (@askastorytelling) at the State Library of WA for a live comics reading event where YOUR participation is vital.

But wait, there’s more! You’ll get to create your very own comic with help from the pros. Then meet the artists, check out the mini-market, grab some comics and maybe score a selfie with your new favourite comics creator!

Bring a friend, make a new one, or come along ready to meet your future comic-making crew. Everyone’s welcome!

PCAF Stories Kids
Where: SLWA Theatre, State Library of Western Australia

When: Sunday 1st of Nov, 10:30am - 12noon
Cost: FREE!
Who: All ages welcome

Hosted by the Perth Comic Arts Festival and the State Library of Western Australia. @statelibrarywa

Stories are brewing and friends are waiting - book your spot now on Humanitix (link in our b!0 and on pcaf.org.au / tickets)

PCAF is heading to MAKE!

Campbell (@campbellwhyte) and Liz (@elizabethmarruffo) are representing PCAF at the very first Melbourne Alternative Comics Expo (MAKE) this weekend.

They will have a table at the Market Hall on Sunday running a Perth Comics Giveaway AND FREE copies of the 2026 Tale Town at the booth so get in quick!

PCAF is excited to be celebrating Australia's newest comic festival! Thank you for having us @makecomicsfestival <3

📚 PCAF MONTHLY ACADEMY FREE WORKSHOPS 📚

✨ A World in a Matchbox: Packing Big Stories into Small Spaces ✨
with Maha Malik @mwahaha_art
Join local artist Maha Malik for a big afternoon of tiny stories! Maha's focus is on traditional art and traditional crafts, and telling stories through non-traditional mediums.

Participants will create their own miniature comic contained within a matchbox, transforming an everyday object into a small, handmade world. Using drawing, painting, collage and other elements - rather than digital perfection - participants will distil a small part of their life, interests or imagination into a tiny book, object or collection of objects. 

RECOMMENDED: Bring scissors and a gluestick!

📅 When: Sunday October 4th, 2pm-4pm
📍 Where: State Library of WA, Geographe Room, ground floor (fully accessible)

✏ Header art by @worf_episode

PCAF, in association with the Musée de la Bande Dessinée (@comicartmuseumbxl), is very proud to announce that the inaugural WA comics-artist residency in Brussels is awarded to Alicia Rutigliano! @aliciarose_art 

From a long-listed field of 16, PCAF sent five shortlisted applications to Brussels for a final selection to be made.

Judges at the Musée de la Bande Dessinée awarded the residency to Alicia for a well-developed project, the quality of the art and storytelling, as well as for the proposal’s clarity about the benefits access to the Museum’s resources would bring to Alicia’s comics work.

Congratulations Alicia! We know you’ll do WA and PCAF proud!

We hope to run this program again in 2027. Please keep an eye out for the announcement during PCAF 2027!

✨ PCAF STORIES KIDS EXPRESSION OF INTEREST CALLOUT!! ✨

Do you make comics for kids?

Would you like to share your comics with a live audience of young comic fans?

PCAF Stories is looking for new presenters for Kids PCAF Stories, happening Sunday 1 November at the SLWA Theatre.

If you’re based in WA, or you’ll be in Boorloo for the event, we’d love to see what you make! 

Send us your work via the form in our bio, or here: https://forms.gle/GfaVTFp8rTQUAk366 

Come and inspire the next generation with your work !

🇦🇺 🇧🇪 BRUSSELS COMIC ARTIST RESIDENCY PROGRAM APPLICATIONS CLOSE TONIGHT 🇧🇪 🇦🇺

The Perth Comic Arts Festival, in association with the Musée de la Bande Dessinée @comicartmuseumbxl, is very proud to present the first comics-artist residency in Brussels available to Western Australian artists.
Between October and December 2026, for three weeks, the Museum is hosting Belgian and international comic artists in Brussels for an artistic residency. This residency, with the support of PCAF, is available to a Western Australian comics-maker. The residency will bring together artists to share, explore, and inspire one another.

The Museum undertakes to organize the residency with the Artist to enable them to work optimally on their project, following the Artist for the duration of the residency and doing its best to:
🗯️ Provide help and advice on their work
🗯️ Share professional contacts and facilitate meetings
🗯️ Invite the Artist to public or networking events that would happen during its stay
🗯️ Include the Artist in the Museum activities, if the programming allows it
🗯️ The Museum will also provide the artist with 50€ per diem for up to 21 days

PCAF will support the artist by:
🗯️ Assisting the artist with finding accommodation in Brussels for the duration of the residency
🗯️ Provide $3000 AUD towards accommodation costs for the duration of the residency
🗯️ Provide $2000 AUD towards return flight costs to Brussels from Perth

WHO CAN APPLY?
Comic artists meeting all of the following criteria:
🗯️ A practicing comics artist based in Western Australia with a graphic novel or long-form comic currently in process
🗯️ An Australian citizen or Permanent Resident with an up-to-date passport
🗯️ At least 18 years of age

Please head to pcaf.org.au/2026-brussels-residency for full details on the residency and the application guidelines!

IMPORTANT DATES
🗯️ Applications open: 26th of July, 2026
🗯️ Applications close: 14th of August, 2026
🗯️ Applicants notified: 31st of August, 2026
🗯️ Residency Period: 3 continuous weeks, between the 10th of October and 15th of December (to be decided in consultation with PCAF and the Museum).

💥✨ HELP PCAF BECOME BIGGER AND BETTER WITH A QUICK SURVEY!! ✨💥

Read the full comic at: pcaf.org.au/survey-comic
If you attended our festival weekend- we want your feedback!!

We are a volunteer-run not-for-profit organisation, and grants allow us to make this festival 100% free to attend! Grants are highly dependent on feedback to show our impact on the community, so if you could take a few minutes to fill out our feedback form we would greatly appreciate it, as it helps us to ensure the best chance of receiving funding in the future.

Fill in our survey at: https://pcaf.org.au/feedback/

Thank you for coming along to our wonderful (not so little anymore) festival and letting us know some info to help make it even better!

Art by the wonderful @theirdandelion, the full comic is available againin 2025's edition of Tale Town and on the website here: pcaf.org.au/survey-comic
